name: Winged
source: Pathfinder Howl of the Wild, Winged adjustment (pg. 123), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=29
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Howl of the Wild is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds Acrobatics equal to its highest skill modifier, a fly Speed equal to its highest Speed, and Dropping Dodge.

abilities.name: Dropping Dodge
abilities.description: Requirements {Name} is flying; Trigger An enemy targets {name} with a Strike; Effect {Name} folds its wings and drops to avoid the hit at the last second. {Name} gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the Strike. After the Strike resolves, {name} drops 15 feet. Even if it is stopped by the ground, it doesn't take falling damage.
